{{Top|leg}}
'''Volpau's amulet''' was an extremely valuable amulet which was engraved with details of the ancestry of [[Volpau]], a third cousin of Emperor [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. The amulet was placed in a casket alongside Volpau's body after his death, which was then placed onboard the [[ZZ-class freighter|ZZ-class]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Mingula]]''. The vessel was bound for Coruscant so that Volpau's body could receive a ritual cremation. However, the ship then became lost, and drifted in space for a long period instead of arriving at its destination. The bounty hunter [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] then discovered the ''[[Mingula]]'' drifting in space while he was transporting a captive prisoner called [[Tsumo]], and the bounty hunter then boarded the vessel with his prisoner. They soon discovered the amulet within the casket. However, the [[Ubuugan fleshborer]]s, who had killed Volpau by burrowing inside his body and using him as a host, then burst out of the corpse and attacked Fett, who killed them with his flamethrower. The flames then burned the ''Mingula''<nowiki/>'s power cells, which set off a chain reaction, but Fett then escaped the vessel in a garbage container with the amulet before the vessel exploded, and he planned to break up the amulet and sell the pieces to interested buyers.<ref name="Boba Fett ½: Salvage">[[Boba Fett ½|''Boba Fett'' ½]]</ref>
